root_type_pretty:
∀ (W : Turing.FinTM Bool) (a b : ℕ) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (x : List Bool), W.ComputesInTime x (T x.length).bits (b * (T x.length + 1))) →
    ∀ (x : List Bool),
      ∃ τ ≤ b * (T x.length + 1),
        ∃ c,
          c.state = none ∧
            c.output = (T x.length).bits ∧
              Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg (List.map (⇑Complexity.oblEmbed) x)) (τ + 1) =
                Complexity.clockStageCfg W a c
